title: Review of Quantum Mechanics
subject: Quantum Theory of Solids
description: A compact refresher before the solid-state material: states and rays, bras and inner products, orthonormal bases, operators and eigenvalues, Hermitian observables, measurement, expectation and variance, commutators and the uncertainty relation, then position-space QM with the position and momentum operators and plane waves.

title: Special Relativity and Flat Spacetime
subject: General Relativity
description: Newtonian gravity recast (inverse-square law, Poisson's equation), a quick rederivation from the gravitational Gauss law, and the first step into GR: gravity as curvature, not force.
